programme.title: The Group
programme.desc: Eight young women from the Vassar College class of 1933 rush out into the world to find exciting lives, but discover nothing is quite as they dreamed. Rather than blazing trails in art, science and literature, the friends are each variously burdened with disappointing relationships, children, aging parents and unemployment. Kay Strong (Joanna Pettet), the center of the group, gradually loses faith in the promise of their lives and, as war approaches, becomes unhinged.

programme.title: The Sultan's Daughter
programme.desc: An American woos the daughter (Ann Corio) of an Arab (Charles Butterworth) who's defending his oil fields from Germans.

programme.title: Witness to Murder
programme.desc: From her window, Cheryl Draper (Barbara Stanwyck) sees a neighbor, Albert Richter (George Sanders), murder a young woman. When Cheryl goes to the police, they cannot find any evidence because Richter has hidden the body. Cheryl persists in her claims without evidence, leading concerned policeman Larry Mathews (Gary Merrill) to worry that she is becoming obsessed. After Richter becomes aware of Cheryl's accusations, he conspires to make it appear that she is insane.

programme.title: Top Banana
programme.desc: Tyrannical TV star Jerry Biffle (Phil Silvers) wants to boost the sagging ratings for his comedy series. What better way to do that than by casting a couple of hot young bodies -- Sally Peters (Judy Lynn) and Cliff Lane (Danny Scholl) -- as eye candy for the viewing public? The plan gets complicated when Jerry falls for Sally, who really loves Cliff. Adapted from the hit Broadway musical, "Top Banana" is notable for filming the actual stage production on the original sets.

programme.title: Adventures of Kitty O'Day
programme.desc: Kitty O'Day (Jean Parker) is a switchboard operator at a busy hotel where her boyfriend, Johnny (Peter Cookson), also works. Suspicious about some strange noises, she sends Johnny to her employer's apartment, where Johnny finds the boss has been murdered. Kitty is determined to find the culprit, but the hotheaded Inspector Clancy (Tim Ryan) is also on the case, and, as more bodies pile up at the hotel, the police start to throw accusations at Kitty and her amateur crime-solving crew.

programme.title: Ladybug, Ladybug
programme.desc: The teachers and students of a countryside elementary school are thrown into a panic when an air raid siren goes off, warning them of an imminent nuclear attack. They are unaware that it has gone off by mistake, and separate the children into groups -- one of which is headed by the anxious Mrs. Andrews (Nancy Marchand) -- to take them home. Harriet (Alice Playten) invites her classmates into her family's bomb shelter, but tragedy strikes when she won't allow one of her classmates to enter.

programme.title: Wild in the Streets
programme.desc: Archetypal 1960s musician Max Frost (Christopher Jones) lends his backing to a Senate candidate who wants to give 18-year-olds the right to vote, but he takes things a step further than expected. Inspired by their hero's words, Max's fans pressure their leaders into extending the vote to citizens as young as 15. Max and his followers capitalize on their might by bringing new issues to the fore, but, drunk on power, they soon take generational warfare to terrible extremes.

programme.title: Lost Lagoon
programme.desc: Charlie Walker (Jeffrey Lynn), a middle-aged businessman, grows weary of his middle-class life and his family. Once there, he mixes with the locals and falls in love with a younger woman, Elizabeth Moore (Leila Barry). But Walker starts to feel the strain of his new life and wonders if he made the right decision.

programme.title: De Sade
programme.desc: The 18th-century French marquis (Keir Dullea) recalls his sadomasochistic experiments and goes to jail for lewd behavior.

programme.title: Toys in the Attic
programme.desc: Black sheep Julian Berniers (Dean Martin) returns home -- along with wife Lily (Yvette Mimieux) -- to his two sisters in New Orleans. Julian's shoe factory in Illinois has gone bankrupt, but he tells them he saved enough money to be comfortable. Julian's sister, Carrie (Geraldine Page), nurses a borderline incestuous affection for Julian and dislikes Lily. When Carrie overhears Julian revealing his money was swindled from Cyrus Warkins (Larry Gates), she convinces naive Lily to betray Julian.

programme.title: Mystery of the 13th Guest
programme.desc: A young woman opens her grandfather's will when she turns 21, and someone starts murdering the heirs.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: An old junk dealer's (Hugo Haas) chorus-girl bride (Cleo Moore) and helper (Vince Edwards) run into his twin brother.

programme.title: Things You Can Tell Just by Looking at Her
programme.desc: In California, a group of women struggles with personal problems as their paths intertwine in unexpected ways. Dr. Elaine Keener, the sole caretaker for her aging mother, turns to tarot card reader Christine for spiritual aid. Christine grapples with her own angst due to her lover's debilitating illness. Meanwhile, a bank manager deals with an unwanted pregnancy, two sisters pursue romantic interests and a housewife gets back into the dating game.

programme.title: Popi
programme.desc: Genial Puerto Rican widower Abraham Rodriguez, known as "Popi" to his preteen sons, grapples with poverty and hardship in their Spanish Harlem neighborhood. Desperate to provide his sons every opportunity to succeed, and noting the reverence with which Americans treat Cuban immigrants, Popi lights upon a wild scheme. He sets his boys afloat in a boat off the coast of Florida, confident that they will be "rescued" as Cuban refugees and adopted by wealthy patrons.

programme.title: So Young, So Bad

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Cult of the Damned
programme.desc: An unscrupulous rock star brings decadence and debauchery to a naive young woman's wealthy household.

programme.title: The Trip
programme.desc: Paul (Peter Fonda), a director saddened by his failed marriage and unsatisfied with his work, is looking to start over. His friend, the cool, sage-like John (Bruce Dern), suggests that an LSD trip is exactly what Paul needs to get out of his rut. Paul decides to indulge, and experiences visions that are alternately beautiful and terrifying. His hallucinations, which include a carnival populated by dwarfs, bizarrely erotic encounters and even his own death, radically reshape his consciousness.

programme.title: The Miracle Worker
programme.desc: Blind and deaf after suffering a terrible fever as a baby, young Helen Keller (Patty Duke) has spent years unable to communicate, leaving her frustrated and occasionally violent. As a last chance before she is institutionalized, her parents (Inga Swenson, Andrew Prine) contact a school for the blind, which sends half-blind Annie Sullivan (Anne Bancroft) to teach Helen. Helen is initially resistant, but Annie gradually forms a bond with her and shows Helen ways of reaching others.

programme.title: The Emerald Forest
programme.desc: American Bill Markham (Powers Boothe) has taken his family to the jungles of Brazil, where he has been hired to design a dam. Unexpectedly, a native tribe abducts his son, Tommy (Charley Boorman). Bill spends an entire decade looking for Tommy, only to discover that the boy has adopted the ways of the indigenous people he's been living with. Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe.

programme.title: Something Wild
programme.desc: When college girl Mary Ann Robinson (Carroll Baker) is attacked and raped, her world is shattered. Unable to carry on a normal routine with her critical mother, Mary Ann takes a room in a New York City hovel and accepts a job at a dime store as she struggles to come to grips with her ordeal. Sinking into isolation, she attempts suicide and is saved by a concerned bystander, lonely auto mechanic Mike (Ralph Meeker). Mary Ann moves in with Mike but soon questions his motives for wanting to help.

programme.title: Buona Sera, Mrs. Campbell
programme.desc: During World War II, an Italian villager (Gina Lollobrigida) befriends three American soldiers. Later, when unsure which of them fathered the daughter she has, she invents a dead captain named Campbell, declares herself his widow and accepts support checks from all three soldiers. Twenty years later, a reunion unexpectedly brings the three veterans -- and their wives and children -- back to Italy. Mrs. Campbell panics as she endeavors to keep her lively past from her daughter.

Bill tries to convince his son to return to his family, but their reunion is interrupted when another group of natives attacks Tommy's tribe.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Little Norse Prince Valiant
programme.desc: A Norwegian prince fights evil with a rock man's sword of the sun.

programme.title: The Purple Plain
programme.desc: At the end of World War II in Burma, Canadian Royal Air Force pilot Forrester (Gregory Peck) is a loner whose bravery can't cover a streak of reckless instability. When his actions cause an injury, he is nearly transferred, but Dr. Harris (Bernard Lee) recommends pulling him from duty, due to the emotional trauma he's suffered. Forrester then accompanies Harris to a Christian missionary outpost, where he meets Anna (Win Min Than) and begins to find interest in living again.

programme.title: The Secret of NIMH 2: Timmy to the Rescue
programme.desc: In this animated film, after recovering from an illness that plagued him in his youth, country mouse Timmy Brisby (Ralph Macchio) grows into a strong young rodent. And when fellow Thorn Valley resident Jenny McBride (Hynden Walsh) begs him to find her missing mother and father, he gets the opportunity to prove himself worthy of the Brisby name. Timmy sets out on a journey that puts him on a collision course with wicked mouse Martin (Eric Idle) and the dreaded National Institute of Mental Health.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Sea Fury
programme.desc: The first mate (Stanley Baker) of a British salvage boat rivals his captain (Victor McLaglen) for a Spanish girl (Luciana Paluzzi).

programme.title: Black Girl
programme.desc: The 17-year-old dreamer Billie Jean is the youngest in a family of loving yet discouraging women. Billie Jean's mother, Mama Rosie, cares deeply about her three biological children. However, her own personal disappointments have left her embittered, and she only offers encouragement to her adopted daughter, Netta. When Netta, a successful teacher, returns to visit the family, she may be the voice of guidance and hope Billie Jean desperately needs.

programme.title: Visit to a Chief's Son
programme.desc: When a Western anthropologist, Robert (Richard Mulligan), brings his son, Kevin (John Philip Hogdon), to Kenya to document an eclipse and a remote Masai tribe's reaction to it, both father and son are in for a serious case of culture shock. Used to Western comforts, Kevin is at first hesitant and uncomfortable among the natives, but the English-speaking son of the tribe's chief, Nemolok (Johnny Sekka), helps familiarize Kevin with his culture, opening his eyes to a new way of life.

programme.title: The Kitchen Toto
programme.desc: In the 1950s Kenya, a preacher (Nathan Dambuza Mdledle) speaks out against the Mau Mau terrorists and is killed for it, leaving his young son, Mwangi (Edwin Mahinda), to fend for himself. Mwangi goes to work in the kitchen of the local British police chief, John Graham (Bob Peck), who welcomes him -- though his wife (Phyllis Logan) and son (Ronald Pirie) treat Mwangi with contempt. Things worsen when the Mau Mau intercede in his life again, this time demanding that Mwangi ally himself with them.

programme.title: Anna Lucasta
programme.desc: Anna Lucasta has been walking the streets in San Diego since being thrown out of home, at 19, by her alcoholic father, Joe. She's estranged from her family, but when her father and brother-in-law see greedy potential in an arranged marriage to affluent Rudolph, Anna is called back home. Old wounds have hardly healed, though. Just as Anna starts to feel for Rudolph, Danny, an old friend, returns to make life difficult.

programme.title: Halls of Anger
programme.desc: The court-ordered desegregation of an inner-city Los Angeles high school brings 60 white students into the predominantly African-American student body. African-American teacher Quincy Davis (Calvin Lockhart) reaches out to all his students, enticing Lerone (DeWayne Jessie) to advance his reading skills with racy paperbacks, protecting new student Douglas (Jeff Bridges) after a race-motivated beating and trying to quell a potential student strike led by the militant J.T. (James A. Watson Jr.).

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily.

programme.title: Drum
programme.desc: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: The Monkey Hustle
programme.desc: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: Slaughter
programme.desc: After his parents are killed by a car bomb, a former Green Beret named Slaughter (Jim Brown) begins investigating and is shocked to discover they were targets of a Mafia hit. He decides to settle the score on his own and successfully takes out some of the gangsters responsible before being caught by police. Now faced with a murder charge, Slaughter strikes a deal with government officials to have the charges dropped provided he can find and kill another gangster who's since fled to Mexico.

programme.title: Crack House
programme.desc: Rick (Gregg Thomsen) and Melissa (Cheryl Kay) are two young lovebirds struggling against the crime and poverty of the Los Angeles ghetto they inhabit. Their hopes of ever leaving are destroyed when one of Rick's relatives is killed in a drive-by shooting. Seeking to avenge the vicious murder, Rick rejoins his former gang, but gets himself arrested. During his absence, Melissa becomes involved with drug dealers and is addicted to crack. Rick then sets out on a difficult mission to save her.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.desc: A Chicago police officer practices his own brand of justice to take down the killers who murdered his partner.

programme.desc: An FBI agent (Beau Bridges) and a detective (Bubba Smith) tie ghetto drugs and mayhem to a colonel's (Lloyd Bridges) white supremacists.

programme.title: Hollywood Shuffle
programme.desc: Aspiring actor and hot-dog stand employee Bobby Taylor (Robert Townsend) catches the ire of his grandmother (Helen Martin) for auditioning for a role in the regrettably titled exploitation film Jivetime Jimmy's Revenge. When Tinseltown Studios casts Taylor in the title role, he has a series of conflicted dreams satirizing African-American stereotypes in Hollywood, and must reconcile his career goals with his desire to remain a positive role model for his little brother (Craigus R Johnson).

programme.title: Cotton Comes to Harlem
programme.desc: Harlem's African-American population is being ripped off by the Rev. Deke O'Malley (Calvin Lockhart), who dishonestly claims that small donations will secure parcels of land in Africa. When New York City police officers Gravedigger Jones (Godfrey Cambridge) and Coffin Ed Johnson (Raymond St. Jacques) look into O'Malley's scam, they learn that the cash is being smuggled inside a bale of cotton. But the police, O'Malley and lots of others find themselves scrambling when the money goes missing.

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: Body and Soul
programme.desc: Leon Johnson (Leon Isaac Kennedy) is a boxer who plans to study medicine, but, with his ailing sister, Kelly (Nikki Swassy), in need of costly care, he decides to earn a living in the ring. His rise is rapid, but Leon's newly extravagant lifestyle threatens his relationship with girlfriend Julie (Jayne Kennedy). As Leon approaches the sport's highest echelons, he faces increasingly tough decisions that test his loyalty to his family and himself.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone gets a lift from prostitute Linda in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

programme.title: Escort West
programme.desc: In the wake of the Civil War, ex-Confederate soldier Ben Lassiter and his 10-year-old daughter, Abbey, are traveling through Nevada when they cross paths with sisters Martha and Beth Drury. Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection.

programme.title: Canyon Crossroads
programme.desc: Henchmen in a helicopter chase a Utah prospector (Richard Basehart) seeking uranium with a professor and his daughter (Phyllis Kirk).

programme.title: Wild Horse Stampede
programme.desc: The Trail Blazers (Ken Maynard, Hoot Gibson) stop horse rustlers for Indians and a railroad.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Bat faces a series of challenges as his crew builds a railroad in Colorado, including natural disasters, lost equipment and charges against Bat for a murder he didn't commit.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: When Bat comes to the aid of a marshal friend in Dodge City to stop a power-hungry land baron named Silas Guild, he learns the marshal's intentions are less than noble.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: Billy Clanton makes a pass at Lisa Carew, getting into a fight with her father, who has promised Lisa to Johnny Coster; Lisa runs away from her home.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: After discovering his wife has been kidnapped, a man recently released from prison learns that she will be released if he kills Clay Hollister.

programme.title: Gun Fight
programme.desc: After finishing a stint as a cavalryman, Wayne Santley (James Brown) is looking forward to taking a job on his brother's ranch. While traveling to see his sibling, he helps entertainer Nora (Joan Staley) out of a sticky situation with an aggressive suitor, and promptly falls in love with her. But when he and Nora finally meet up with Wayne's brother, Brad (Gregg Palmer), they learn the ranch is just a front for a crime ring. Wayne is appalled, leading to a feud between the brothers.

programme.title: A Dog's Best Friend
programme.desc: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

programme.title: The Gunfight at Dodge City
programme.desc: Gambler and gunman Bat Masterson (Joel McCrea) rides into Dodge City, Kan., to visit his straight-arrow brother, Ed (Harry Lauter), who is hoping to defeat crooked sheriff Jim Regan (Don Haggerty) in an upcoming election. Bat purchases and renovates a rundown saloon, attracting the notice of Regan's henchmen. A shooting during the saloon's opening-night celebration causes Bat to pursue his own political vendetta against Regan and attempt to clean up the town's corruption once and for all.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Man With the Gun
programme.desc: Sheridan City is out of control. The citizens are corrupt, the saloon is an immoral indulgence, and gunmen and greedy opportunists come and go as they please. With the town's lawman (Henry Hull) incapable of maintaining order, the town council brings in a hired gun, Clint Tollinger (Robert Mitchum), who has business of his own with the saloon madame (Jan Sterling). Tollinger sets about proving his reputation as a "town tamer" through his signature approach: eradicating violence with violence.

But when they run into a group of murderous Apaches, Hamish and Kallen must fight together to survive, and they form an unlikely friendship.

programme.desc: A disparate group of individuals enters a horse race through 700 miles of the Wild West to win a large cash prize. La chasse au trésor a coûté jusqu'ici des millions de dollars et a impliqué des dizaines de spéculateurs, ingénieurs, personnalités connues comme Franklin D. Roosevelt. programme.title: Kennedy
programme.sub-title: À l'orée de la guerre (octobre 1962 - juin 1963)
programme.desc: Pour sortir le pays d'une possible guerre nucléaire, Kennedy poursuit la diplomatie avec les Soviétiques et décide d'aborder la question des droits civiques comme aucun président ne l'avait fait auparavant : comme une question morale.

programme.title: Les grands mystères de l'Histoire
programme.sub-title: L'incident de la forêt de Rendlesham
programme.desc: Un événement complètement stupéfiant survenu aux abords d'une base aérienne près de la forêt Rendlesham, en Angleterre, est devenu une véritable légende. Il s'agit également d'une des possibles rencontres extraterrestres les plus étranges de toute l'histoire... Depuis plus de 40 ans, la question demeure : qu'y avait-il réellement dans la forêt Rendlesham? Et quels étaient tous ces faisceaux lumineux mystérieux?

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.sub-title: De la poudre et des balles
programme.desc: Tom utilise un fusil à chargement par la bouche traditionnel pour chasser le cerf avec Sean et Hank. La chasse à l'élan de Jake et Anika est couronnée de succès. programme.title: Les montagnards: en Alaska
programme.desc: Marty doit sortir son avion de brousse d'un gros banc de neige; Bret et Ivy échappent à une avalanche depuis le toit de leur cabane avant d'entamer le voyage de retour vers leur base ; Mike récupère son bateau en panne.

programme.title: L'Ouest avec Kevin Costner
programme.desc: Le colonel Henry Carrington prend le commandement de Fort Phil Kearny, dans le nord du Wyoming; il n'est pas préparé à devoir y affronter un ennemi aussi féroce que le clan des Sioux Oglala Lakota, dirigé par le chef Red Cloud; avec des champs à perte de vue, l'infanterie de Carrington est une proie facile; l'arrivée de l'officier de cavalerie William Fetterman ne fait qu'empirer la situation; Crazy Horse, le protégé de Red Cloud, pourrait porter un coup fatal à Carrington et ses hommes.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: SOS Yukon
programme.desc: L'agent de protection de la faune Logan échappe de peu au danger en enquêtant sur un cas de braconnage, tandis qu'un grizzli agressif saccage la cabane isolée d'un trappeur.

programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.sub-title: Romain et à portée de main
programme.desc: Après une nouvelle découverte suggérant que le mystère d'Oak Island pourrait avoir des liens anciens avec l'Italie, l'équipe enquête sur une structure en pierre dont le design correspond étonnamment à celui du puits principal.

programme.title: Dangereuse époque avec Henry Winkler
programme.desc: Vous pensiez que votre travail était difficile? Eh non! Voici les professions carrément dangereuses d'autrefois, des chapeliers empoisonnés au mercure aux enfants rampant dans les cheminées, en passant par les projectionnistes fuyant les incendies. programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.desc: Une récente découverte faite sur le lot 5 est bel et bien un artefact religieux. Les membres de l'équipe entreprennent alors un forage qui s'avère gagnant. Ils font une autre découverte surprenante en plein coeur de la zone du puits principal.

programme.title: Mystères vus du ciel
programme.desc: Une possible vraie Atlantide, des cratères jumeaux géants inexpliqués, une mystérieuse île d'ours polaires et un super-volcan caché.

programme.title: Bulletin spatial
programme.sub-title: La grande histoire de l'exploration de la lune
programme.desc: Accompagné du polyvalent metteur en scène Robert Lepage, de Daniel Rey et d'Isabelle Tremblay, de l'Agence spatiale canadienne, Pierre-Yves propose de les suivre dans la fascinante conquête de notre satellite terrestre, la Lune.

programme.title: Bulletin spatial
programme.sub-title: Les grandes découvertes des sondes voyager
programme.desc: En 1977, deux sondes étaient lancées qui n'ont cessé depuis d'étonner; ces missions d'exploration du système solaire sont sans doute les plus fructueuses sur le plan scientifique de l'histoire spatiale, et transmettent encore aujourd'hui des données.

programme.title: Nature en équilibre
programme.desc: La réserve de la biosphère Manicouagan-Uapishka est fière de collaborer avec l'industrie pour créer un avenir durable ; cependant, son rêve est mis à l'épreuve quand son projet phare est menacé par le plus grand réservoir hydroélectrique.

programme.title: Qu'est-ce qui se passe quand...?
programme.sub-title: Qu'est-ce qui se passe quand on pousse le corps au-delà de ses limites d'endurance sportive?
programme.desc: Sébastien repousse ses propres limites physiques en améliorant sa performance au fameux test navette Léger-Boucher; pour l'aider dans sa quête, il n'hésite pas à appliquer les conseils d'un champion des burpees.

programme.title: Qu'est-ce qui se passe quand...?
programme.desc: Sébastien veut comprendre ce qui motive les amoureux de l'extrême; pour ce faire, il va rencontrer la spécialiste du stress humain Catherine Raymond; il va lui-même s'exposer aux sensations fortes en pratiquant le trapèze.

programme.title: Sur le terrain avec les intervenants autochtones
programme.desc: À Manawan, des premiers répondants assistent une personne en psychose et portent secours à une jeune qui s'est fait battre ; au dispensaire, un infirmier suspecte un problème cardiaque chez un jeune homme essoufflé.

programme.title: Sur le terrain avec les intervenants autochtones
programme.desc: À Manawan, un infirmier examine un garçon avec des problèmes respiratoires et soupçonne une infection aux conséquences parfois graves ; la directrice du Centre d'amitié autochtone de La Tuque explique que la guérison est plus qu'individuelle.

programme.title: Découverte
programme.desc: L'apnée sportive révèle d'étonnants mécanismes de survie du corps humain; climat: réconcilier les générations est-il la clé pour passer à l'action?; à quoi servent vraiment nos lobes d'oreille?

programme.title: Machines colossales
programme.desc: Sonder les mystères de l'univers nécessite des machines incroyables, fleurons de l'ingénierie. Focus sur la conception des navettes spatiales, du Crawler-transporter de la NASA, de la Station spatiale internationale et du Très Grand Télescope.

Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. programme.title: Les Pierrafeu
programme.desc: Les Pierrafeu étaient la famille moderne de l'âge de la Pierre. Résidant dans la ville Saint-Granit, Fred Caillou n'était pas satisfait de son travail à la carrière, mais revenait à la maison auprès de sa charmante épouse Wilma et, enfin de sa fille Agathe. Fred, un grand amateur de golf et de quilles aimait aussi taquiner son voisin Arthur Laroche, tandis que la femme coquine d'Arthur, Bertha était la meilleure amie de Wilma. Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. Les Pierrafeu, fortement inspiré par "The Honeymooners" ont convaincu une génération d'enfants que dinosaures et humains ont occupé la planète en même temps.

programme.title: Live: Sports 30
programme.desc: Les plus récents dénouements dans le monde du sport. On analyse en profondeur les résultats des dernières 24 heures dans toutes les disciplines. Hockey, football, baseball, Formule 1, rien n'échappe à nos animateurs qui discutent également des dossiers chauds tels les rumeurs d'échange, le repêchage des futurs espoirs, les scandales reliés au dopage sans oublier une dose d'humour avec quelques gags bien placés par des collaborateurs de longue date et la fameuse compilation des plus beaux jeux du jour. De l'action en toute saison.

programme.title: Parlez-moi d'amour
programme.desc: Justine et Richard, mariés depuis quinze ans, ont eu ensemble trois enfants. Ils furent naguère très amoureux, mais le quotidien les a usés. Les silences s'éternisent, lourds de reproches et de sous-entendus. Chaque jour, Justine prépare les enfants pour l'école et chaque jour, à son retour, la même dispute éclate. Justine critique l'alcoolisme et la pesanteur de Richard, qui, de son côté, lui reproche ses infidélités passées. La crise semble sans issue et les enfants en pâtissent.

programme.title: Une rencontre
programme.desc: Elsa et Pierre mènent chacun de leur côté des vies professionnelles et personnelles très accomplies. Pour lui, l'infidélité est inenvisageable; pour elle, l'homme marié est une erreur. Un soir, au gré du hasard, ils se rencontrent.

programme.title: Les looney tunes
programme.desc: Ces courts-métrages Looney Tunes relatent les aventures de célèbres personnages tels que Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Elmer Fudd, Sylvestre (Grosminet), Titi, Marvin le Martien, Taz le diable de Tasmanie, Bip Bip et Coyote, Charlie le coq, Sam le pirate, Pépé le putois, Gossamer et bon nombre d'autres personnages.

programme.title: 100% loup
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin, héritier d'une fière famille de loups-garous, est certain qu'il deviendra le plus redoutable de tous les loups-garous. Or, le jour de son 13e anniversaire, quelle n'est pas sa surprise lorsque sa première translouptation tourne mal et qu'il se transforme en un féroce petit caniche. Juste au moment où Freddy pense que sa vie ne peut pas être pire, il est rejeté par sa meute et se fait attraper par la fourrière. Freddy et sa nouvelle amie Batty vont tenter de s'échapper.

programme.title: Hommes en noir III
programme.desc: Les agents J et K sont de retour dans le temps. J a vu des choses inexplicables au cours de ses 15 ans avec les Hommes en noir, mais rien, pas même les extraterrestres, ne le laisse aussi perplexe que son partenaire désabusé et réticent. Cependant, lorsque la vie de K et le sort de la planète sont mis en jeu, l'agent J doit voyager dans le temps pour remettre les choses en ordre. Il découvre qu'il y a des secrets dans l'univers dont K ne lui avait jamais parlé.

programme.title: TVA Nouvelles
programme.desc: On présente l'actualité de dernière heure en temps réel, les nouvelles régionales, internationales et économiques, et plus encore. En provenance de Montréal pour les stations des marchés de l'ouest du Québec (Gatineau, Ottawa, Sherbrooke, Trois-Rivières et Rouyn-Noranda) et de Québec pour les stations de l'est du Québec (Rimouski, Rivière-du-Loup, Carleton sur Mer et Saguenay). On couvre toute l'actualité québécoise.

programme.title: La poule aux oeufs d'or
programme.desc: Julie Houle et Sébastien Benoît accueillent six participants, qui sont assurés de gagner un lot et courent la chance de remporter le gros lot ; chaque joute comprend le jeu des roulettes, le jeu des portes et le célèbre jeu de l'œuf ou l'enveloppe.

programme.title: Chanteurs masqués
programme.desc: Spécial Halloween! Les chanteurs masqués offrent des prestations à faire frissonner; la soirée se termine avec une double élimination surprise qui secoue la compétition.

programme.title: MasterChef Québec
programme.desc: Les candidats devront se fier à leurs cinq sens pour sauver leur tablier; lors d'une épreuve, ils devront accumuler de bonnes réponses afin de gagner des ingrédients pour cuisiner; seul un plat complexe qui éveille tous les sens leur permettra d'éviter l'élimination; l'animateur globe-trotter et gourmet Benoît Roberge se joint aux juges pour l'occasion.

programme.title: J.E.
programme.desc: Des enquêtes sur le terrain, des fraudes mises au jour ; c'est ce qui est promis de l'émission animée par le journaliste et auteur, Félix Séguin.

programme.title: TVA Nouvelles
programme.desc: On présente l'actualité de dernière heure en temps réel, les nouvelles régionales, internationales et économiques, et plus encore. On couvre toute l'actualité québécoise.

programme.title: Sur les chemins noirs
programme.desc: Un soir d'ivresse, Pierre, écrivain explorateur, fait une chute de plusieurs étages. Cet accident le plonge dans un coma profond. Sur son lit d'hôpital, revenu à la vie, il se fait la promesse de traverser la France à pied du Mercantour au Cotentin. Un voyage unique et hors du temps à la rencontre de l'hyper-ruralité, de la beauté de la France et de la renaissance de soi.

programme.title: Tout s'est bien passé
programme.desc: Emmanuèle, romancière épanouie dans sa vie privée et professionnelle, se rend à l'hôpital où se trouve son père André, qui vient de faire un AVC. Fantasque, aimant passionnément la vie, curieux de tout, mais diminué, il demande à sa fille de l'aider à mourir. Avec l'aide de sa soeur Pascale, elle va devoir choisir: accepter la volonté de son père ou le convaincre de changer d'avis.

programme.title: Le prodige
programme.desc: L'histoire de Bobby Fischer, le prodige américain des échecs, qui a l'apogée de la guerre froide se retrouve pris entre le feu des deux superpuissances en défiant l'Empire soviétique lors du match du siècle contre Boris Spassky. Son obsession de vaincre les Russes va peu à peu se transformer en une terrifiante lutte entre le génie et la folie de cet homme complexe qui n'a jamais cessé de fasciner le monde.

programme.title: Hit Squad Outdoors With Tim Sylvia

programme.title: Game On With Blaine Anthony
programme.desc: After 24 days of trying to harvest an Axis Buck, this is Blaine's last shot to get it done.

programme.title: Wiebe Trapline Adventures
programme.sub-title: Maine Fisher/Marten with Ken, Bob, Butch
programme.desc: In the quiet, deep woods of northern Maine, three aging trappers chase marten and fisher. Ken, Bob and Butch enjoy the camaraderie, the wilderness and a bountiful catch as they trek through the incredible, scenic timber of the Maine backcountry.

programme.title: Guns & Gear

programme.title: Savage Outdoors
programme.desc: Hunting big south Texas whitetails.

programme.title: How to Hunt With Ryan Kohler
programme.sub-title: Close Calls in Alberta Elk Country Part 1
programme.desc: Bulls are bugling as Ryan and Louie DeBrusk return to Alberta elk camp for another shot at success; in studio, co-host Jim Thomson breaks down tactics for hunting thick timber.

programme.title: The Canadian Tradition
programme.desc: Taylor Wright goes on a family outdoor adventure; he takes his daughters on a spring wild turkey hunt.

programme.title: Waterfowl East
programme.desc: Matt is met with a challenge to set up in the open with no cover or try and hug a tree line. Wind isn't allowing the tree line hunt so we make the tree line come out of the woods and smack-dab in the middle of the field. High risk, great reward.

programme.title: Dean Partridge's Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: A long season and no target bucks, Dean puts the time in to produce encounters while bowhunting Saskatchewan.

programme.title: The Wild Outdoors
programme.desc: Come along with Jay and Wyatt Gregory as they share The Wild Outdoors! A bowhunting series in its 32nd year has something for everyone! programme.title: Informe Robinson
programme.sub-title: La pasión según Chimmy Ávila - La nostalgia de Abdon Pamich
programme.desc: Cuando Ezequiel Ávila atravesaba la puerta de su casa en un precario barrio de Rosario, Argentina, se topaba con una cancha de fútbol. Crecido en aquel potrero en un rincón olvidado, el niño al que apodaron Chimy, quinto de nueve hermanos, se ha acostumbrado a superar situaciones límite: carestía económica, denuncias, años sin jugar, la grave enfermedad de una hija recién nacida y, ahora, una grave lesión en el mejor momento de su carrera. Pero el jugador de Osasuna ha sorteado cualquier obstáculo aferrado a su pasión por el fútbol y sus convicciones religiosas.

programme.title: El fútbol según Raúl
programme.desc: El 4 de junio de 1980 vivimos un partido histórico en el fútbol español, porque nunca se había disputado y nunca más se disputará. Esa noche saltaban al césped del Santiago Bernabéu los jugadores del Real Madrid y los once de su filial para disputar la final de la Copa del Rey. 40 años después Raúl se propone contarnos aquella historia del Castilla matagigantes y qué fue de los jugadores que vivieron aquella noche tan especial.

programme.title: El fútbol según Raúl
programme.desc: En tiempos de confinamiento, Raúl, encerrado en su casa, echa la vista atrás para recordar todas aquellas historias que ha contado a lo largo de su trayecto profesional en las pantallas de Movistar +. Tras revisar fotos, vídeos y recuerdos, decide llamar a buena parte de aquellos protagonistas y amigos que ha ido conociendo en el camino para saber de su nueva realidad a causa del coronavirus. Un viaje de Wuhan a Soria, pasando por Chile o Japón en el cual Raúl, una vez levantado el confinamiento, muestra la cara más trágica del virus, descubre héroes anónimos y retrata el estado del fútbol profesional y amateur en una época sin fútbol.

programme.title: Universo Valdano

programme.title: Cuando Figo volvió al Camp Nou
programme.desc: El 21 de octubre se cumplen 20 años de la vuelta de Figo al Camp Nou con la camiseta del Real Madrid. La marcha del portugués creó un gran trauma en la afición azulgrana, que le tenía como uno de sus mayores ídolos. La historia de desamor tuvo su punto culminante en su regreso a Barcelona como jugador blanco, en un partido que quedará para la historia. Dos décadas después, la herida parece no haberse cerrado.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. Andrea Fuentes, locura artística
programme.desc: Andrea Fuentes ha sido uno de los nombres del deporte español en 2025. Pero su historia va mucho más allá, desde sus años de nadadora a las órdenes de Anna Tarrés a su medalla de plata con Estados Unidos, digna de un guion de Hollywood. Con una personalidad y un método únicos, la actual seleccionadora de natación artística plantea una visión del deporte de élite rompedora y llena de carisma, mientras en lo personal rebosa humanidad y emoción.

programme.title: Dakar: carrera contra el desierto
programme.desc: Durante décadas, el Rally Dakar ha sido mucho más que una carrera: es la máxima prueba de resistencia, habilidad y pasión en el mundo del motor. Este documental ofrece un acceso sin precedentes al corazón del Dakar 2023, acompañando a los protagonistas en una travesía de 9.000 kilómetros y 14 días a través de los paisajes más extremos y desafiantes del desierto.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. México 86 el vuelo del Buitre
programme.desc: El Mundial de México 86 reunió para España situaciones rocambolescas, partidos históricos y el sueño de una victoria casi impensable. Varios componentes de aquella generación rememoran peripecias, jugadas y anécdotas de una competición que encumbró a Emilio Butragueño y mostró al mundo que España estaba cambiando. El fútbol era el reflejo de un país que ese año celebraba las cuartas elecciones generales tras la dictadura, que se incorporó a la Comunidad Económica Europea y que conoció que Barcelona sería olímpica.

programme.title: Euroliga de baloncesto: Milan - FC Barcelona
programme.desc: El Barça (3-3) visita la cancha de uno de los colistas, el Olimpia Milán (1-5) después de ganar a Maccabi y caer con Olympiakos la semana pasada. El equipo italiano viene de perder en casa contra Real Madrid y Dubai. El equipo azulgrana, uno de los mejores ataques de Europa, espera sacar provecho de la débil defensa lombarda que encaja más de 93 puntos por partido y es al equipo al que le anotan con más altos porcentages.

programme.title: Informe Plus. Toni Bou, 40 de 40
programme.desc: Toni Bou lleva casi dos décadas haciendo posible lo imposible. Desde 2007, el piloto de trial ha construido una trayectoria sin precedentes hasta alcanzar una cifra extraordinaria: 40 títulos mundiales. Pero detrás de los récords, las victorias y una superioridad que parece no tener fin, hay una historia de sacrificio, dolor, evolución y una ambición intacta.Este Informe Plus muestra desde dentro la conquista de su Mundial número 40, un hito con el que Toni Bou ha vuelto a hacer historia y se consagra como uno de los deportistas más laureados de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: Euroliga de baloncesto: Maccabi Tel Aviv - Real Madrid
programme.desc: Los 20 mejores equipos del continente luchan por el título de la Euroliga, que este año se decidirá en la Final 4 de Abu Dabi. La armada española estará compuesta por Real Madrid, Barça, Valencia y Baskonia, que aspiran a reeditar el éxito de la pasada temporada de Blancos y Taronjas que llegaron a disputar la Final 4. Este curso los enemigos a batir serán los dos equipos griegos, Olympiakos y Panathinaikos. Los Rojos, actuales campeones, vuelve a ser los grandes favoritos. Los Verdes se han reforzado mucho este verano para tratar de volver a ser campeones de Europa. Los banquillos hablarán castellano, con 7 entrenadores españoles: Laso, Pascual, Albert, Mumbrú, Martínez, Navarro y Peñarroya.

programme.title: Guerra de Clásicos
programme.desc: 18 días. Tres competiciones. Cuatro partidos. Entre el 16 de abril y el 3 de mayo de 2011, Real Madrid y Barcelona vivieron cuatro clásicos. Algo que no había pasado nunca y que difícilmente se volverá a repetir. Messi, Cristiano, una docena de campeones del mundo sobre el césped y un duelo que se elevó por encima de los demás, el de los banquillos. Era la tercera temporada de Pep Guardiola en el Camp Nou, el debut de José Mourinho en el Bernabéu. Dos estilos de juego y dos personalidades muy diferentes. Aquella primavera de 2011, la "Guerra de Clásicos" no sólo se jugó en el césped. También en las salas de prensa, con declaraciones que han quedado ya para la historia. Diez años después, se puede revivir aquellos días frenéticos con la perspectiva del paso del tiempo, pero contagiándose aún de la intensidad que supuso vivir algo espectacular e irrepetible.

programme.title: Liga F: At. Madrid - Valencia
programme.desc: El crecimiento del fútbol femenino se ve reflejado semana a semana en la Liga F, la máxima competición de clubes de España. El Barcelona, dominador de la competición durante las siete últimas temporadas, es el rival a batir. Los otros 15 equipos pretenden plantar cara.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. México cuando Maradona se hizo D10S
programme.desc: La obra maestra de Diego Armando Maradona. La actuación individual más prodigiosa de la historia de los Mundiales de fútbol. Escritores, periodistas y varios componentes de aquella selección dirigida por Carlos Bilardo recuerdan un triunfo que viajó acompañado de críticas constantes, revanchas históricas y conflictos internos. Sus protagonistas nos relatan el camino que convirtió a un grupo dividido en un conjunto imbatible.

programme.desc: Toni Bou lleva casi dos décadas haciendo posible lo imposible. Desde 2007, el piloto de trial ha construido una trayectoria sin precedentes hasta alcanzar una cifra extraordinaria: 40 títulos mundiales. Pero detrás de los récords, las victorias y una superioridad que parece no tener fin, hay una historia de sacrificio, dolor, evolución y una ambición intacta.Este Informe Plus muestra desde dentro la conquista de su Mundial número 40, un hito con el que Toni Bou ha vuelto a hacer historia y se consagra como uno de los deportistas más laureados de todos los tiempos.

programme.title: Villeneuve-Pironi: velocidad y tragedia
programme.desc: Gilles Villeneuve y Didier Pironi fueron grandes amigos y compañeros de equipo en Ferrari durante la época dorada de la Fórmula 1, en los años ochenta. Los unía su amor por la velocidad, pero un momento decisivo los separó para siempre.

programme.title: Lomu
programme.desc: Jonah Lomu fue la primera superestrella global del rugby. Este retrato íntimo del legendario jugador neozelandés recorre su infancia en Tonga, su meteórico ascenso a la fama y las complejas dificultades personales y de salud que enfrentó en la cima del deporte mundial.

programme.title: Informe Plus. Atypical Spanish
programme.desc: El patinaje sobre hielo español vive una etapa de transformación, frescura y vanguardia. La británica Olivia Smart y el alemán Tim Dieck conforman una alianza tan singular como brillante que compite con orgullo y entusiasmo representando a España. Herederos y continuadores del camino trazado por el gran referente de nuestro patinaje, Javier Fernández, este tándem ha conquistado a jueces, público y rivales con su estilo renovador.

Es la primera vez que España juega la Davis en terreno chileno. Es un duelo lleno de trampas. El billete para Bolonia 2026 está en juego.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. Nayanesh. Las cicatrices de un león
programme.desc: Nayanesh Ayman es mucho más que una leyenda del Muay Thai. El español de origen congoleño ha convertido su carrera en una lucha personal contra la violencia machista. ‘Nenés’, como le llaman en su barrio de Alcorcón, fue junto a su madre víctima de malos tratos siendo solo un niño, y empezó a pelear “para que nadie le volviera a poner la mano encima a mamá”. Hoy Nayanesh es doble campeón del mundo y quiere seguir haciendo historia como uno de los peleadores más importantes de la historia, y un gran referente en cuanto a valores.

programme.desc: In diretta dal Centro Sportivo Romagna 1 di Cesena (FC) partita valida per l'ottava giornata del Campionato Primavera, si sfidano Cesena e Monza.

programme.title: Campionato Argentino San Lorenzo-Estudiantes
programme.desc: Dall'Argentina partita valida per la tredicesima giornata della Liga Professional, si sfidano San Lorenzo e Estudiantes.

programme.title: Campionato Saudita Al Qadisiyah-Al Hilal
programme.desc: Dall'Arabia Saudita partita valida per l'undicesima giornata della Saudi Pro League, si sfidano l'Al Qadisiyah e l'Al Hilal guidato da Simone Inzaghi.

programme.title: Campionato Argentino Belgrano-River Plate
programme.desc: Dall'Argentina partita valida per la tredicesima giornata della Liga Professional, si sfidano Belgrano e River Plate.

programme.title: اسمي ملك
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول ملك التي تحاول بناء حياة جديدة مع عائلتها، كما تجاهد من أجل البقاء مع أطفالها الثلاثة. Gaziantep-born Melek is married and has three kids. Her life is turned upside down when her spouse leaves her alone and takes the kids with him.(n)

programme.title: Forbidden Apple
programme.desc: يسلط مسلسل (التفاحة المحرمة) الضوء ضمن أحداثه على عالم رجال الأعمال والثراء الفاحش، والصراع الذي يصنعه الحب من جانب، وسيطرة المال على البشر من جانب آخر. The events highlight the world of businessmen and extreme wealth, the conflict created by love on the one hand, and the control of money over people on the other.(n)

programme.title: بهو الست لميا
programme.desc: في إطار كوميدي، تتمحور الأحداث حول شخصية الست لميا ومساعدها أبو شادي، والفندق الذي تديره، حيث يجمع شخصيات متنوعة من خلفيات اجتماعية وثقافية مختلفة. تنشأ بينهم سلسلة من المفارقات اليومية والمواقف الطريفة المشوقة، والتي تعكس تفاصيل الحياة اليومية بأسلوب ساخر ومرح.(n)

programme.title: حدوتة حب
programme.desc: في إطار درامي تدور الأحداث حول أربع قصص (الشهر السابع، طفلي المتوحد، شهر عسل، الهاجس) يجمع بينهما دافع الانتقام والخيانة. A drama that covers four stories (the Seventh Month, My Autistic Child, Honeymoon, and Obsession), all of which are connected by the theme of infidelity and revenge.(n)

programme.title: لولا الحب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول الفتاة مسا (نادين الراسي) التي تعمل وسط مجال إعلامي كبير وتستغل تلك الوظيفة في تسليط الضوء على مجموعة من القضايا والمشاكل الهامة في المجتمع متحدية العديد من الشخصيات ذو السلطة والنفوذ.. في ذات الوقت تحاول اتخاذ قرار بشأن علاقتها غير الشرعية وحملها. The series revolves around Missa, who works in a large media field and sheds light on a range of important issues and problems in society in defiance of many figures with power and influence, while she tries to decide on her affair and pregnancy.(n)

programme.title: علاقات خاصة
programme.desc: يجسد كل زوجين قصة درامية تتشابك أحداثها بشكل أو بأخر مع العلاقات الأخرى بدءًا من «جو» رجل الأعمال المتزوج من «ياسمين» التي تنتمي لبيئة فقيرة ليصنع منها نجمة غناء، وترتبط حياة «جو وياسمين» بـ «حسام» المتزوج من «فرح»، بالرغم من رفض أهلها لهذا الزواج بسبب فارق السن، أما «جهاد» فيقع ضحية إنتقام مزدوج من أخته «رنا» و«إياد» حبيب زوجته المستقبلية «لامار»، أمّا «تيم» فيحب «مايا» رغم اختلاف الديانة. The events of each couple's story are intertwined with other relationships, starting with Jo, a businessman married to Yasmin, who becomes a singing star. Hossam who is married to Farah. While Jehad is the victim of double revenge from his sister Rana and Eiad. As for Tayem, he's in love with Maya despite having a different religion.

programme.title: دورة جونية جبيل
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث في إطار كوميدي متصل منفصل حول سائق أتوبيس يعمل على خط “دورة -جونية-جبيل” والذي يتعرض بسبب ظروف عمله لأحداث كثيرة، منها كوميدية ومنها رومانسية. In a series of separate episodes, a bus driver on the Daoura-Jounieh-Byblos line is exposed to many events, including comedic and romantic ones.

programme.title: نهاركم سعيد
programme.desc: برنامج صباحي يومي، يهتم بمناقشة آخر المستجدات على الساحة السياسية، من خلال إستضافة المحليين السياسيين، لمناقشة القضايا التي تهم الرأي العام في لبنان. كان البرنامج عند انطلاقته بعام 1996 يتناول الأحداث السياسية بفقرة صغيرة مدتها نصف ساعة وبقية فترة البرنامج كانت حول أمور ثقافية ومنوعة. A regular morning program that hosts local politicians to talk about subjects that are important to the people in Lebanon and to debate the latest events in the political scene. When it was launched in 1996, the program dealt with political events in a small segment lasting half an hour, and the rest of the program period was about cultural and other matters.

programme.title: بيروت 303
programme.desc: تتفجر طائرة بيروت 303 فوق شاطئ لبنان، فتحول حياة القلة من الناجين إلى رحلة بحث عن الحقيقة، ضمن إطار غامض ومليء بالشك. The Beirut 303 plane explodes over the coast of Lebanon, turning the life of the few survivors into a truth-searching journey.(n)

programme.title: وأخيرا
programme.desc: خيال ابنة غير شرعية تبنتها سيدة فقيرة قامت برعايتها، ابتسم القدر لخيال حيث جمعتها قصة حب مع ياقوت؛ ولكن حادثة خطف تقلب حياتها رأسًا على عقب. Khayal is an illegitimate daughter who was adopted by a poor woman who took care of her. Fate smiled at Khayal, as she was brought together by a love story with Yaqout, but a kidnapping turns her life upside down.(n)

programme.title: ثواني
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول ممرضة وزوجها يعيشان حياة عادية، ولديهم علاقات جيدة بالناس المحيطة بهم، لكن حياتهما تتغير بسبب حادث يقع لهما يقلب حياتهما رأسًا على عقب، فيدخلان في صراع مع الشخصيات التي تحيط بحياتهما وسط صراع متشابك يسعيان فيه لمواجهة الأطراف الأخرى. The story of a nurse living peacefully with her husband in a neighborhood where they are liked and accepted by everyone. However, their lives are turned upside down when they get involved in an accident, leading to problems with everyone around them.(n)

programme.title: بيروت 303
programme.desc: تتفجر طائرة بيروت 303 فوق شاطئ لبنان، فتحول حياة القلة من الناجين إلى رحلة بحث عن الحقيقة، ضمن إطار غامض ومليء بالشك. The Beirut 303 plane explodes over the coast of Lebanon, turning the life of the few survivors into a truth-searching journey.(n)

programme.title: The Best Thing
programme.desc: تدور الأحداث حول (شين شيفان)، مديرة فندق مهووسة بالعمل، تلتقي بالطبيب الهادئ (خه سو يه) أثناء بحثها عن علاج. ورغم أن علاقتهما تبدأ طبيعية، فإن الصدفة تجمعهما كجيران، فتتطور بينهما مشاعر حب. The events revolve around Shen Xifan, a workaholic hotel manager, who meets the quiet doctor He Su Ye while searching for a cure. Although their relationship begins professionally, coincidence brings them together as neighbors, and feelings of love develop between them.(n)

programme.title: Barbaros: Sword of the Mediterranean
programme.desc: يحكي المسلسل قصة حياة البحار خير الدين بربروس، الذي صنع بطولات لا تنسى للإمبراطورية العثمانية في عهد السلطان سليم الأول، والذي ضمن السيادة العثمانية في البحر الأبيض المتوسط، وكان من أكبر مؤيدي خير الدين بربروس شقيقه عروج بربروس الذي تمكن من السيطرة على جميع السواحل. The story of the life of the sailor Hayreddin Pasha "Barbarossa" and his unforgettable heroics for the Ottoman Empire during the reign of Sultan Selim I, which guaranteed Ottoman sovereignty in the Mediterranean. One of Barbarossa's biggest supporters was his brother Oruc, who managed to control all the coasts.

programme.title: أولاد الراعي
programme.desc: من نقطة الصفر وجذور بسيطة، ينطلق ثلاثة أشقاء في رحلة كفاح مريرة لبناء إمبراطورية تجارية تهز عالم المال. ومع تضخم الثروة والنفوذ، يتحول النجاح إلى اختبار قاسٍ لروابط الدم؛ حيث تتشابك المصالح وتنفجر صراعات السلطة والولاء بينهم. يضعهم العمل أمام خيارات مصيرية تهدد الكيان الذي بنوه معاً، كاشفاً كيف يمكن للمال أن يغير القلوب ويقلب الأشقاء إلى خصوم في ساحة معركة لا ترحم. From scratch, three brothers embark on a bitter struggle to build a business empire. As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.

Although their relationship begins professionally, coincidence brings them together as neighbors, and feelings of love develop between them.

programme.title: مطبخ رؤيا
programme.desc: برنامج (مطبخ رؤيا) يُقدم مقادير وطرق تحضير العديد من المأكولات والأطباق المحلية والعربية والعالمية. The program Roya Kitchen presents the ingredients and methods for preparing many local, Arab, and international foods and dishes.

programme.title: مطبخ رؤيا
programme.desc: برنامج (مطبخ رؤيا) يُقدم مقادير وطرق تحضير العديد من المأكولات والأطباق المحلية والعربية والعالمية. The program Roya Kitchen presents the ingredients and methods for preparing many local, Arab, and international foods and dishes.

programme.title: كرڤان
programme.desc: برنامج شبابي يذاع على قناة رؤيا الفضائية يستعرض كل ما يهم الشباب من أخبار على مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي مثل أمور الموضة والطبخ وهموم الحياة ويتم فيه أيضًا عمل إستفتاءات غريبة.

programme.title: نقطة انتهى
programme.desc: يجاهد الصيدلي (فارس يعقوب) من أجل إخفاء جريمته الأولى التي ارتكبها عن طريق الخطأ بحق شقيق زوجته المراهق، فيما تسعى زوجته إلى كشف حقيقة مقتل شقيقها الوحيد. The pharmacist, Fares Yacoub, struggles to hide his first crime, which he committed by mistake against the teenage brother of his wife, who seeks to uncover the truth about the murder of her only brother.

programme.title: رسوم متحركة
programme.desc: السنافر شخصيات خيالية صغيرة الحجم، زرقاء اللون، وتعيش في الغابة، تمثل عائلة السنافر الكثير من الشخصيات مختلفة الطباع، والسنافر كثر. للسنافر عدو كريه هو شرشبيل الشرير وقطه الأحمر المشاكس "هرهور" اللذان يعيشان في القلعة المهجورة. The Smurfs are small, blue-colored creatures living in mushroom houses in an enchanted forest. Their peaceful life is constantly interrupted by the evil wizard Gargamel and his nasty cat Azrael who live in an abandoned castle.

programme.title: خبز وملح
programme.desc: يعالج المسلسل مشكلة السمنة التي باتت ظاهرة سلبية تشغل المجتمعات العربية والقائمين على وسائل الإعلام فيها و يهتم بالصحة العامة ويقدم النصيحة الطبية والمعلومة الصحية للمشاهدين، من خلال عائلة تعاني من مشاكل صحية مختلفة بسبب عاداتهم الغذائية السيئة. The series addresses the problem of obesity, which has become a negative phenomenon that preoccupies Arab societies and the media. It focuses on public health and provides medical advice and health information to viewers, through a family suffering from various health problems due to their poor eating habits.

programme.title: مطبخ رؤيا
programme.desc: برنامج (مطبخ رؤيا) يُقدم مقادير وطرق تحضير العديد من المأكولات والأطباق المحلية والعربية والعالمية. The program Roya Kitchen presents the ingredients and methods for preparing many local, Arab, and international foods and dishes.

programme.title: نبض البلد
programme.desc: برنامج سياسي يتناول العديد من القضايا المحلية والعربية والعالمية، يستضيف متخصصين ويعرض تقارير ميدانية ويتواصل مع الجمهور من خلال التعليقات عبر مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي ويطرحها على الضيوف خلال الحلقة. A political program that addresses many local, Arab, and international issues. It hosts specialists, presents field reports, communicates with the public through comments on social media sites, and presents them to the guests during episodes.

programme.title: كرڤان
programme.desc: برنامج شبابي يذاع على قناة رؤيا الفضائية يستعرض كل ما يهم الشباب من أخبار على مواقع التواصل الاجتماعي مثل أمور الموضة والطبخ وهموم الحياة ويتم فيه أيضًا عمل إستفتاءات غريبة. A youth program broadcast on Roya TV that shows all the news that concerns young people on social networking sites, such as fashion, cooking, and life concerns, and strange polls are also conducted.

programme.title: أبناء القهر
programme.desc: يعيش الزوجان عصام ورجاء في حالة كبيرة من الشجار والخلاف والشقاق بسبب رغبة زميلته في العمل في الزواج منه، وهذا الخلاف يترك مع الوقت آثاره السلبية على أولادهما. Essam and Rajaa are a married couple who experiences unsolvable problems and disputes because one of Essam's co-workers wants to marry him. These disputes affect their children negatively over time.

programme.title: النويلاتي
programme.desc: في حارة النوياتي التي تغلي بصراعات السلطة والمال، تنطلق حكاية يمتزج فيها الواقع بالأساطير. يعود الغواص من وراء قضبان سجن وُصف بالمقبرة، عائدا بهوية غامضة ووجه غريب ليخترق الحارة من جديد. لا يسعى الغواص للانتقام من الذين خانوه فحسب، بل يقتفي أثر "كنز مفقود" يُقال إنه محروس بطلسم قديم. وفي ظل هذه الظروف القاسية تتقاطع الدروب مع مكائد تجار الدماء، حيث تصبح الهوية المزيفة هي الدرع الوحيد بمعركة البقاء. In the Al Nwaylati neighborhood unfolds a tale where reality and myth intertwine. Ghawwas comes out of prison, seeking not only revenge against those who betrayed him but also pursues a lost treasure. Amidst these harsh circumstances, his path crosses with the machinations of ruthless profiteers, making his assumed identity his only shield in the battle for survival.

programme.desc: في إطار درامي تشويقي، يتناول العمل صراع ثلاثة أشقاء على أملاك وثروة والدهم الحي، بينما تقف أختهم الوحيدة بين أطماعهم المتصاعدة، لتظل النهاية معلقة بسؤال: من ينتصر في هذا الصراع العائلي. programme.title: الحياة اليوم
programme.desc: برنامج مسائي يومي يناقش كافة الأوضاع السياسية والاجتماعية والاقتصادية فى مصر، وتستضيف من خلاله اﻹعلامية لبنى عسل يوميًا أبرز الشخصيات على الساحة في مصر. A daily evening program that discusses all political, social, and economic situations in Egypt, through which media personality Lubna Asal hosts the most prominent figures on the scene in Egypt daily.(n)

programme.title: شارع شريف ج4
programme.desc: يقدم البرنامج فقرات ترفيهية ومتنوعة بشكل جديد ومختلف، ومنها فقرات (فن، مطبخ، فاشون شو، أبراج وطاقة، أطفال، أعياد ميلاد)، وذلك من خلال ديكور البرنامج وهو عبارة عن شارع ممتد محاكاة للشارع الحقيقي الذي يحتوي على كوافير إلى جانب مطعم وأماكن للمشاة وللجلوس وعيادة. The program presents various entertainment segments in a new and different way, including art, cooking, fashion, horoscopes, children, and birthdays, through the set design of the program, which is an extended street simulating a real street, which contains a hairdresser, along with a restaurant, pedestrian areas and a clinic.(n)

programme.title: فرصة أخيرة
programme.desc: يجد قاضٍ مشهود له بالنزاهة نفسه أمام اختبار مصيري يضعه على المحك؛ حين تُختطف حفيدته للمساومة على عدالته، فيصبح محاصراً بين غريزة إنقاذها وبين الثبات على مبادئه التي عاش يدافع عنها. A judge known for his integrity finds himself facing a fateful dilemma that puts him to the test. When his granddaughter is kidnapped to sway his ruling, he becomes trapped between the instinct to save her and upholding his principles that he lived to defend.(n)

programme.title: الإمام الطيب
programme.desc: برنامج يقدمه شيخ الأزهر أحمد الطيب، يتناول فيه عدد من القضايا التي تهم المجتمع المصري والعربي، والمسلمين وغير المسلمين، ومن بينها قضايا المرأة والشباب والإلحاد والإرهاب. A program presented by Grand Imam of Al Azhar, Ahmed El Tayeb, in which he addresses several issues of concern to Egyptian and Arab society, Muslims and non-Muslims, including issues of women, youth, atheism, and terrorism.(n)

programme.title: واحد من الناس
programme.desc: يسلط البرنامج الضوء على العديد من المشاكل التي كان يعاني منها المواطنون المصريون وخاصة من هم تحت الدخل المتوسط ويهدف إلى خدمة الأماكن التي لا يعرفها أحد. The program highlights many of the problems that Egyptian citizens, especially those with low incomes, suffer from and aims to serve locations that no one knows about.(n)

programme.title: أولاد الراعي
programme.desc: من نقطة الصفر وجذور بسيطة، ينطلق ثلاثة أشقاء في رحلة كفاح مريرة لبناء إمبراطورية تجارية تهز عالم المال. ومع تضخم الثروة والنفوذ، يتحول النجاح إلى اختبار قاسٍ لروابط الدم؛ حيث تتشابك المصالح وتنفجر صراعات السلطة والولاء بينهم. يضعهم العمل أمام خيارات مصيرية تهدد الكيان الذي بنوه معاً، كاشفاً كيف يمكن للمال أن يغير القلوب ويقلب الأشقاء إلى خصوم في ساحة معركة لا ترحم. From scratch, three brothers embark on a bitter struggle to build a business empire. As wealth grows, success turns into a severe test of blood ties, where interests intertwine and power and loyalty struggles clash between them. The brothers are faced with fateful choices that threaten the entity they built together, revealing how money can turn siblings into opponents on a merciless battlefield.(n)

programme.title: وتر حساس ج2
programme.desc: في الموسم الثاني، يعود رشيد إلى وطنه ساعيًا لاستعادة مكانته داخل عائلته عبر الزواج من ابنة عمه فريدة. لكن زواجهما يكشف عن أسرار صراع قديم بين رشيد ووالد فريدة، لتشتعل الخلافات العائلية تدريجيًا. ومع خروج كاميليا من السجن، تبدأ مواجهة جديدة تتشابك فيها مشاعر الحب والانتقام، ليتحول العمل إلى صراع إنساني واجتماعي تتداخل فيه القيم والعواطف في أجواء مثيرة. In season 2, Rashid returns to his homeland, seeking to restore his status within his family by marrying his cousin, Farida. However, their marriage reveals the secrets of an old conflict between Rashid and Farida's father, gradually escalating family disputes. With Camelia's release from prison, a new confrontation begins, intertwining feelings of love and revenge.(n)

programme.title: ستهم
programme.desc: بعدما يُقتل زوجها، تدخل (ستهم) في عدة صراعات مع أسرتها وتحاول تربية أبناءها بعيدا عن المشاكل، ثم تضطر للتنكر في هيئة رجل حتى تواجه الصعوبات التي تقابلها في الحياة. After her husband is killed, Settohom gets into several conflicts with her family and tries to raise her children away from problems; however, she is forced to disguise herself as a man to face the difficulties she encounters in life.

programme.desc: برنامج نسائي يومي يتضمن العديد من الفقرات التي تهم المرأة من طبخ ومكياج وموضة بالإضافة إلى فقرات أخرى خاصة بالسياسة والاقتصاد وكل القضايا الاجتماعية ولكن بعيون النساء، وأيضًا يستضيف العديد من الضيوف الذين يتم محاورتهم حول كل ما يهم الأسرة والمرأة بشكل خاص. programme.title: أمين وشركاه
programme.desc: سلسلة من العروض المسرحية الكوميدية التي يقوم ببطولتها النجم الكوميدي أحمد أمين على خشبة مسرح جامعة مصر للعلوم والتكنولوجيا، وفي كل مرة عرض كوميدي مختلف. A series of comedic theatrical performances by Ahmed Amin. Each episode is a different comedy show with different themes.

programme.title: آخر النهار
programme.desc: برنامج حواري يرصد أهم القضايا المصرية وأحدث الأخبار، بخلاف نجاحه في كشف كثيرٍ من القضايا السياسية والاجتماعية والاقتصادية التي تهم المواطن. يقدمه كوكبة من الإعلاميين بينهم (محمود سعد، وعادل حمودة وخالد صلاح) بشكلٍ شبه يومي، يستضيف مجموعة من خبراء الاقتصاد والسياسة وعلم الاجتماع ولا يضر ذكر أطباء الطب النفسي وعلماء الدين من أجل تثقيف المواطن وفهم مجريات الأمور ،ومحاولة فضح المسكوت عنه وكشف أسباب وحلول تلك القضايا. A talk show about current events and Egyptian politics, society, and economy with media specialists like Mahmoud Saad, Adel Hamoda, and Khaled Salah as hosts. Economics, politics, and sociology experts get hosted, as well as mental health professionals and religious scholars who may help citizens examine, discover, and find solutions.(n)

programme.title: روج أسود
programme.desc: يتناول مجموعة قصص درامية مستوحاة من الواقع تتعلق بـ نساء يواجهن مشاكل حقيقية في حياتهن الزوجية والعائلية، وتتقاطع الأحداث داخل محكمة الأسرة المصرية، حيث تُعرض قضايا متنوعة تتجاوز الخيانة والانفصال إلى تعقيدات اجتماعية أكثر عمقًا. It follows a number of stories inspired by true events related to women facing real problems in their marital and family lives, and the events intersect within the Egyptian Family Court, where various cases are presented that go beyond betrayal and separation to deeper social complexities.

programme.title: السقوط في بئر سبع
programme.desc: يدور المسلسل حول قصة حقيقية من ملفات المخابرات المصرية، حول تجنيد مصري وزوجته للتجسس لصالح إسرائيل، القصة نقلًا عن رواية (إبراهيم وانشراح) للكاتب الصحفي عبدالرحمن فهمي. Based on the novel "Ibrahim and Inshirah" by journalist Abdel Rahman Fahmy, the series revolves around a true story from the Egyptian intelligence files, about the recruitment of an Egyptian man and his wife to spy for the benefit of Israel.

programme.title: إسأل مع دعاء
programme.desc: برنامج ديني يعتمد على استضافة مُقدمته (دعاء فاروق) لشيخ أو داعية إسلامي، وذلك بهدف الرد على استفسارات وتساؤلات الجمهور حول مختلف الأمور الدينية والدنيوية. A religious program in which the presenter Doaa Farouq hosts an Islamic sheikh or preacher, with the aim of responding to the audience’s inquiries and questions about various religious and worldly matters.

programme.desc: برنامج حواري يرصد أهم القضايا المصرية وأحدث الأخبار، بخلاف نجاحه في كشف كثيرٍ من القضايا السياسية والاجتماعية والاقتصادية التي تهم المواطن. يقدمه كوكبة من الإعلاميين بينهم (محمود سعد، وعادل حمودة وخالد صلاح) بشكلٍ شبه يومي، يستضيف مجموعة من خبراء الاقتصاد والسياسة وعلم الاجتماع ولا يضر ذكر أطباء الطب النفسي وعلماء الدين من أجل تثقيف المواطن وفهم مجريات الأمور ،ومحاولة فضح المسكوت عنه وكشف أسباب وحلول تلك القضايا. A talk show about current events and Egyptian politics, society, and economy with media specialists like Mahmoud Saad, Adel Hamoda, and Khaled Salah as hosts. Economics, politics, and sociology experts get hosted, as well as mental health professionals and religious scholars who may help citizens examine, discover, and find solutions.(n)

programme.title: إسأل مع دعاء
programme.desc: برنامج ديني يعتمد على استضافة مُقدمته (دعاء فاروق) لشيخ أو داعية إسلامي، وذلك بهدف الرد على استفسارات وتساؤلات الجمهور حول مختلف الأمور الدينية والدنيوية. A religious program in which the presenter Doaa Farouq hosts an Islamic sheikh or preacher, with the aim of responding to the audience’s inquiries and questions about various religious and worldly matters.(n)

programme.title: السقوط في بئر سبع
programme.desc: يدور المسلسل حول قصة حقيقية من ملفات المخابرات المصرية، حول تجنيد مصري وزوجته للتجسس لصالح إسرائيل، القصة نقلًا عن رواية (إبراهيم وانشراح) للكاتب الصحفي عبدالرحمن فهمي. Based on the novel "Ibrahim and Inshirah" by journalist Abdel Rahman Fahmy, the series revolves around a true story from the Egyptian intelligence files, about the recruitment of an Egyptian man and his wife to spy for the benefit of Israel.(n)

programme.title: ﺑﺮﻧﺎﻣﺞ توك شو
programme.desc: أحد أهم البرامج الحوارية بدأ إذاعته عام 2006 مع معتز الدمرداش وريهام السهلي، ولكن في عام 2011 انضم الإعلامي عمرو الليثي للبرنامج بعد أن انسحب الدمرداش من تقديمه. يهتم البرنامج بالأخبار المهمة والأحداث اليومية التي تدور في الشارع المصري والعربى، كما يرصد أيضاً اهتمامات المشاهدين وآراءهم وتطلعاتهم، كما يستقبل العديد من الضيوف من رجال السياسة والإعلام والاقتصاد. In 2006, Riham El Sahly and Moataz Al Demerdash hosted one of the most significant talk shows. In 2011, journalist Amr Al Laithy replaced Al Demerdash on the show. The show highlights Arab and Egyptian neighborhood events. Additionally, it tracks viewer objectives, views, and interests. Economists, journalists, and politicians are also regular guests.

programme.title: رسالة الإمام
programme.desc: يحكي المسلسل في إطار تاريخي الأحداث الحقيقية لحياة الإمام محمد الشافعي، والصعوبات التي واجهته أثناء محاولته في نشر رسالته. The series tells the real events of the life of Imam Muhammad al-Shafi'i, and the difficulties he faced while trying to spread his message.

programme.title: رسالة الإمام

programme.title: حرب
programme.desc: تدور أحداث المسلسل حول عضو في أحد الجماعات الإرهابية المتطرفة يدعى (الظافر)، ويحاول تنفيذ عدد من العمليات الإرهابية في مصر، لكنه يتعرض للملاحقة من قبل الأجهزة الأمنية. The events revolve around a member of an extremist terrorist group called Al Zafer, who is trying to carry out a number of terrorist operations in Egypt, but he gets pursued by the security services.

programme.title: حكايات بنات ج5
programme.desc: يستكمل الجزء الخامس من مسلسل (حكايات بنات) متابعة رحلة 4 سيدات (نور، جميلة، جايدا، عائشة) وحياتهن العاطفية، من البدايات الجديدة إلى الفراق والنهايات المأساوية. The journey of the four girls -Nour, Jamila, Jayda, Aisha- continues and their love life, from new beginnings to separation and tragic ends.

programme.title: ريا وسكينة
programme.desc: قصة حياة الأختين (ريا) و(سكينة)، وهما من أشهر مجرمات القرن العشرين في مصر. روعتا النساء في مطلع القرن وكانتا وراء مقتل العشرات، ويعرض المسلسل الظروف التي أدت إلى تحول الأختين ريا وسكينة إلى مجرمتين مستعرضًا تطورات حياتهما وصلتهما بالمحيطين بهما، وتأثير البيئة التي نشأت فيها الأختان على مستقبلهما. The story of the lives of sisters Rayya and Sakina, two of the most famous criminals of the 20th century in Egypt as they terrified women and masterminded dozens of deaths. The series presents the circumstances that led them to becoming criminals and the impact of the environment on their future.(n)

programme.title: صباح البلد
programme.desc: برنامج (صباح البلد) برنامج شامل في موضوعاته ويعرض على قناة (صدى البلد)، تقدمه الإعلامية (دينا رامز). A comprehensive program that airs on the Sada El Balad channel, presented by the journalist Dina Ramez.(n)

programme.title: قلع الحجر
programme.desc: في إطار درامي، تدور أحداث المسلسل في الصعيد، حول قصة حدثت بالفعل، حيث العمدة (فرماوي)، والشاب المتمرد (عبدالحي) الذي يدخل في عدة أزمات بسبب تسلط والديه، كما يتطرق العمل إلى قضية حقوق المرأة. The series is set in Upper Egypt and is based on a true event in which the tyrannical parents of Abdul Hayy, a rebellious young man, force him to face several difficulties. The work also addresses the issue of women’s rights.(n)

programme.title: بـ١٠٠ راجل
programme.desc: في إطار درامي اجتماعي، تدور الأحداث حول (غالية أبو الدهب) التي تواجه العديد من المتاعب، وبعد مقتل زوجها (عادل) خلال حفل زفافهما، تضطر (غالية) للعمل سائقة ميكروباص؛ وتواجه العديد من الصدمات أهمها دخولها السجن. The events revolve around Ghalia Abu Al Dahab, who faces challenges and troubles in her life. She is a woman from a poor area who was forced by circumstances to work as a microbus driver after the death of her husband.(n)

programme.title: الناس الحلوة
programme.desc: برنامج (الناس الحلوة) هو برنامج طبي متخصص، يستضيف البرنامج أطباء لمعرفة معلومات طبية وللرد على الاستشارات. A specialized medical program that hosts doctors to share medical information and to respond to consultations.(n)

programme.title: الكاميرا الخفية
programme.desc: مجموعة من المقالب التي يقع فيها الضيوف، ويقدمها الفنان (إبراهيم نصر)، ومن أبرز الشخصيات التي جسدها شخصية سيدة اسمها (زكية زكريا). A program presented by comedian Ibrahim Nasr, in which a series of pranks are played on the guests, featuring one of the most prominent characters he portrayed, a woman named Zakia Zakaria.(n)

programme.title: حسين على الهوا
programme.desc: يقوم الفنان حسين الأمام بعمل مقالب على عدد كبير من النجوم والمشاهير خلال استضافتهم لهم في برنامجه التليفزيوني. Actor Hussein El Imam plays pranks on a large number of stars and celebrities while hosting them on his television program.(n)

programme.title: بيت الشدة
programme.desc: حفيدة مشعوذ وساحر تُدعى (فَلك) تعود إلى منزل جدها، لأجل الانتقام مِن مَن حرقوا المنزل قديمًا، في ظل وجود لعنة تطارد ابنها سيف وهي سيطرة روح الجد على جسده، فتجد نفسها في مواجهة تصدي أهل الحارة لها بقيادة (مختار) وسرعان ما تتطور الأمور. The granddaughter of a sorcerer and magician named Falak returns to her grandfather's house, in order to take revenge on those who burned the house in the past. However, there is a curse chasing her son Seif, where his grandfather's spirit controls his body.(n)
